personality_one_liner: A professional, rugged yet clean command center built for speed and clarity on the job site.

spacing.rule: Use generous iOS-native rhythms. Content must never touch edges without 'lg' padding. Stick to single-column card layouts for maximum readability.

do's: Apply to sticky headers over scrolling content
Apply to the Weather Hero widget background to ensure text remains readable
dont's: Do not apply to form inputs or general list cards
Do not apply to primary buttons
Ensure underlying content is fully blurred out

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Hub for quick actions, weather overview, and today's task itinerary.

states.empty: Illustration + 'No active tasks today' + 'Start Day' button

screens.layout: Scrollable layout. Top section is a Hero Weather Widget utilizing the 'weather_hero' image with a top-down gradient scrim. Directly below, prominently display the three quick actions (Start Day, Add Break, End Day) as full-width horizontal pill buttons or a 3-column grid depending on space. Below actions, display 'Today's Plan' as a list of single-column cards.

screens.name: Reports
screens.purpose: Feed of daily reports featuring AI-generated summaries and report composer.

states.empty: Clipboard Icon + 'No reports yet' + Primary CTA

screens.layout: Sticky glass header. Scrollable list of report cards containing AI tags. Sticky primary CTA 'Create Report' pinned to the bottom (within a fixed container, safe-area aware) so it is always accessible.

screens.name: Map
screens.purpose: Job site tracking with customer info attached to GPS coordinates.

states.empty: Map centered on current location with no pins

screens.layout: Full-screen 'react-native-maps' component. Implement a split-view style: map on the background, and a bottom sheet ('@gorhom/bottom-sheet') that slides up displaying a list of nearby job sites and active visits. Map pins should use the 'brandPrimary' color.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User management, export views, and admin role settings.
screens.layout: Top section features the 'profile_avatar' image. Below, a grouped list of settings/admin options. Use tinted icon containers ('brandTertiary' bg) for the leading icons in each setting row. Ensure the email digest indicator and export buttons are clearly separated.

weather_hero.alt: Soft white and grey clouds against a pale yellow sky

profile_avatar.alt: a man wearing a white hard hat and black jacket

instructions_to_main_agent: Design follows '1 iOS-Native Clean' with a professional construction feel (Ochre/Mustard accents, highly legible Plus Jakarta Sans).
CRITICAL: Do NOT use ANY shade of blue (including navy/indigo) anywhere. Use Near-Black (#111827) for primary text and Inverse surfaces.
Implement the split-view Map pattern (Map + Bottom Sheet) as researched; it's the standard for managing field operations spatially without losing context.
Ensure the Weather Hero widget has a strict gradient-to-dark scrim pattern so weather data overlaid on it remains perfectly legible.
Apply 'brandTertiary' tinted squares behind icons in Profile setting rows; bare icons look unfinished.
Keep 'Create Report' button in the Reports tab sticky at the bottom, overlapping the scrolling content (with appropriate bottom padding on the list).
